findings.issue: 家 in 家で ('at home') is transcribed や. Standalone 家 as a place noun is read いえ (or うち); や occurs only in compounds (家賃, 家主). Wrong reading in context.
findings.current: ははわいつもやできものをきている。
findings.suggested: ははわいつもいえできものをきている。

findings.issue: Token 家 has reading や; in 家で ('at home') the standalone noun is read いえ. や is only a compound reading.
Romaji propagates the wrong reading of 家 as 'ya'; should be 'ie' (家で = iede).
年 in 年のわりには ('for her age') is transcribed ねん. As a standalone noun meaning age/years it is read とし; ねん is the on-yomi used in compounds/counters. Wrong reading in context.
findings.current: ははわ、ねんのわりにわわかくみえます。
findings.suggested: ははわ、としのわりにわわかくみえます。

findings.issue: Token 年 (glossed 'age') has reading ねん; the standalone noun in 年のわりに is read とし.
Romaji propagates the wrong reading of 年 as 'nen'; should be 'toshi' (年の = toshino).
心ゆく (heart 行く 'to go/reach contentment') rendered literally as 'heart was emptied'. ゆく never means 'to empty'; contradicts expl_en, which correctly says 'the heart to be content'.
findings.current: I made conversation until my heart was emptied (satisfied).
findings.suggested: I made conversation until my heart was content (fully satisfied).

findings.issue: Same error as lit_en: 心ゆく rendered as 'o coração se esvaziar' (empty itself). ゆく = ir/chegar à satisfação, not esvaziar; contradicts expl_pt ('o coração se contentar').
findings.current: Eu, até o coração se esvaziar (ficar satisfeito), fiz conversa.
findings.suggested: Eu, até o coração se contentar (ficar satisfeito), fiz conversa.

findings.issue: Tense mismatch: 反対なの is a present stative ('is against'), but en uses past 'objected', misrepresenting the time reference. pt ('é contra') and lit_en ('is against') are present.
findings.current: My mother objected to my working part time.
findings.suggested: My mother is against me working part time.

findings.issue: The benefactive 〜てくれた is dropped, and expl_en explicitly claims 'the translation includes \'for me\'' — false for this en (pt does have 'para mim'). Adding 'for me' restores the nuance and makes expl_en true.
findings.current: My mother wrapped the sandwiches in paper.
findings.suggested: My mother wrapped the sandwiches in paper for me.

findings.issue: Note derives the te-form with '(した→して)' — した is the past form, not the source of して. Should be '(する→して)' as in the parallel note of sent:tatoeba-82998. Same typo in both the en and pt-BR note strings.
findings.current: te-form of する (した→して), joining 外出 to the auxiliary いる
findings.suggested: te-form of する (する→して), joining 外出 to the auxiliary いる

findings.issue: 'adjetivo-i no plano' drops the word 'forma' (expl_en: 'in the plain form'); 'no plano' reads as 'in the plane/plan' and is not the established term.
findings.current: Como é um adjetivo-i no plano (古い), a frase está em estilo informal/neutro.
findings.suggested: Como é um adjetivo-i na forma plana (古い), a frase está em estilo informal/neutro.

findings.issue: expl_en states the sentence is translated 'with the simple present \'runs/owns\'', but the en field actually says 'has'. Quote should match the actual translation (expl_pt correctly quotes 'tem').
findings.current: which is why we translate it with the simple present 'runs/owns' in English.
findings.suggested: which is why we translate it with the simple present 'has' in English.
